shortDescription: Configures WWNN or WWPN pools on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the WWNN or WWPN pool. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: first_addr
options.description: The first initiator in the World Wide Name (WWN) block. This is the From field in the UCS Manager Add WWN Blocks menu.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: last_addr
options.description: The last initiator in the World Wide Name (WWN) block. This is the To field in the UCS Manager Add WWN Blocks menu. For WWxN pools, the pool size must be a multiple of ports-per-node + 1. For example, if there are 7 ports per node, the pool size must be a multiple of 8. If there are 63 ports per node, the pool size must be a multiple of 64.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the World Wide Node Name (WWNN) or World Wide Port Name (WWPN) pool. This name can be between 1 and 32 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the WWNN or WWPN pool is created.

options.name: order
options.description: The Assignment Order field. This can be one of the following: default - Cisco UCS Manager selects a random identity from the pool. sequential - Cisco UCS Manager selects the lowest available identity from the pool.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: purpose
options.description: Specify whether this is a node (WWNN) or port (WWPN) pool. Optional if state is absent.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify WWNNs/WWPNs are present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify WWNNs/WWPNs are absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
